components.text: The Rune of Capacity increases the capacity of the Blood Altar by an additive +20% per rune.

With Netherite Scrap and Hellforged Parts, you can upgrade a Rune of Capacity to its augmented form, increasing the capacity of the Blood Altar by an additive +40% per rune. If you change your mind, you can undo the upgrade in the Alchemical Reaction Chamber (ARC).
